scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:browser
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:site
scripts.test:ci: npm run test --workspace server -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism && npm run test --workspace web -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism && npm run test:site
